sw07.answer: The parent review process could hang in TUI/post-run finalization after all reviewer/judge children had exited: sending the post-run quit could block, or Bubble Tea shutdown could stall. TUISink.PostRunComplete was changed to send the quit asynchronously, wait for a bounded grace period, then force-kill the Bubble Tea program if shutdown stalls.

required.quote: it has no child reviewer/judge processes left.
robust against both a blocked `Send` and a stuck Bubble Tea shutdown
`TUISink.PostRunComplete()` no longer waits forever.
It now sends the quit message asynchronously, waits briefly, then force-kills the Bubble Tea program if shutdown stalls.
